limitations: Per-sample prelaunch target-file residency is recorded; samples with residual pages are not cache-cold. Shared Windows DLLs/hardware caches and subsequent background reads are uncontrolled; not boot-cold.
Inspectors and tracing enabled; windows may require restore/focus.
Search includes diagnostic polling and 200 ms input-settle delay.

cacheValidation.scope: App, isolated profile and synthetic input file pages at snapshot time; excludes shared Windows DLLs, hardware caches and later background reads.
